answer: Cheap identities hit the audit terrace first: the chain randomly flags 1 in 500 past answers, re-runs the original prompt with a fresh nonce, and demands the agent reproduce semantically equivalent output. Faking 5000 sockpuppets means sustaining 5000 distinct reasoning threads, and each flagged replay costs the agent roughly 3000 tokens (~$0.09) plus a 40-second deadline; a botnet answering off a single cached lotus template fails divergence checks the moment its nonce-shifted transcripts collide, and its bond is slashed on the second mismatch.
